text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Carnage at Kolea market, 30 km southwest of Algiers. A bomb explosion kills 10 people and wounds 73.
- The referendum to amend the constitution may be held at the end of November. The date could be set in the next hours, according to well informed sources.

- A booby-trapped truck exploded about midnight on Thursday in Baghlia town but caused only damage to two disused buildings. Explosion went off while about 15 gunmen clashed with security forces near town hall.
